query: WITH pending AS (UPDATE photos SET status='pending',generation=generation+1 WHERE id=ANY($1) AND status IN ('pending','processing') RETURNING id,original_hash,generation) INSERT INTO jobs(id,kind,payload,max_attempts) SELECT yhotos_uuid_v7(),'ingest',jsonb_build_object('photo_id',id,'original_hash',original_hash,'generation',generation),3 FROM pending
